sources.name: AJPES JOLP — public annual reports database
sources.verdict: VERIFIED live. Free public viewing of annual reports of companies, banks, insurers, institutions; ~150,000 documents, last 5 years; searchable by name/matična/tax number. Core financials source at $0.

sources.name: AJPES eRTR — Register of transaction accounts
sources.verdict: eRTR confirmed as an AJPES product (listed in AJPES site navigation captured this session) but this exact URL was not fetch-verified. Useful for blocked-account/distress signals.

sources.name: AJPES eRDL — Register of beneficial owners

sources.name: OPSI — Slovenian national open data portal (podatki.gov.si)

sources.name: Banka Slovenije (Bank of Slovenia)

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Covers European alternatives funds and LPs; Slovenia coverage is thin — a handful of SI-domiciled or SI-investing GPs/LPs, mostly via pan-CEE funds. Weak on local service graph, NPLs, and lower-mid-market.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: ESMA/national regulator registers (AIFM authorizations), fund annual reports (AJPES JOLP equivalents), LP annual reports (KAD, Modra, SID banka), press releases. We can go directly to ESMA registers, AJPES JOLP, KAD/Modra/SID publications.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Tracks Slovenian VC/PE deals and startups (historically e.g. Outfit7, Celtra, Zemanta exits); decent deal history, weak on registries, real assets and credit.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Company press releases, startup media, LJSE/SEOnet disclosures, business-register filings. Direct routes for us: SEOnet RSS, AJPES ePRS/JOLP, Startup Slovenia news, Finance.si.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Strong SI startup/scaleup coverage via ecosystem partnerships and CEE reports; startup-only lens — no credit, real assets, or institutional graph.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Ecosystem directories (Startup Slovenia, accelerators, Slovene Enterprise Fund beneficiary lists), founder/press submissions. We can use startup.si directory and SPS 'Prejemniki sredstev' lists directly.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Crowd-sourced SI startup profiles; patchy funding data, no registry grounding.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Press releases and self-reported profiles. Direct route: same press signals via RTV/N1/Finance RSS plus AJPES for ground truth.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Full Slovenian company universe with financials, credit flags, blocked accounts (3,688 shown), receiverships (359), new companies — the local reference company-data product. No alternatives/fund lens.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Visibly built on AJPES data: PRS register, JOLP financial statements, eRTR blocked accounts, eObjave insolvency. All of these are public and we ingest them directly from AJPES.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Company intelligence, ownership networks, credit scores and news monitoring for SI corporates; enterprise product, no alternatives taxonomy.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: AJPES PRS/JOLP, court and gazette announcements (eObjave, Uradni list/PISRS), media monitoring. Direct public routes identical to ours.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Credit ratings and payment-default monitoring on SI companies; distress-signal oriented.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: AJPES financial statements, eRTR account blocks, eObjave insolvency filings, FURS tax-debtor lists — all reachable directly at source.

searchedButAbsent: IMPORTANT CAVEAT: this session's WebSearch quota was exhausted (0 searches available), so discovery relied on the known Slovenian source landscape verified through ~30 direct URL fetches; a follow-up search pass could still surface additional niche portals (real-estate media, energy trade press, regional VC newsletters). Genuinely absent or blocked after checking: (1) No active national PE/VC association exists in Slovenia — no operating equivalent of Invest Europe at national level (the historical Slovenian venture-capital association is defunct); coverage is reconstructed from Business Angels of Slovenia, Startup Slovenia, Slovene Enterprise Fund and CEE-level directories. (2) No Slovenia-specific litigation-funding, royalties, ILS or tokenized-RWA registries or media were found — these niches have no dedicated SI sources. (3) No RICS Slovenia chapter directory — the statutory valuer roll lives at the Slovenian Institute of Auditors instead. (4) ATVP registers are machine-inaccessible (WAF 403 reconfirmed) — ESMA registers are the documented workaround. (5) Svet kapitala (Delo's capital-markets vertical) now redirects to Delo's error host — apparently discontinued as a standalone destination. (6) Delo, Dnevnik, Finance.si and Siol RSS endpoints could not be verified (blocked hosts, 404s, or error redirects) — rssUrl recorded only where the feed was actually confirmed (RTV, N1, Necenzurirano, SEOnet). (7) A 'Forbes Slovenia' edition could not be confirmed and was excluded rather than padded. (8) Note for gazette monitoring: Uradni list publication moved to PISRS on 1 Mar 2026 — pipelines must target PISRS going forward."
